property_summary: After the same user calls addToBalance twice with values 1 and 2, the reference contract's getUserBalance returns 3 (sum) and the buggy version returns 2 (overwritten), so the assertion c.getUserBalance(user) == 3 passes on the reference but fails on the buggy version.
change_summary: Change addToBalance to set userBalance to msg.value instead of adding to it, so the balance is overwritten on each call.
